source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), your selected shooter with LEAGUES OF VOTANN can invoke Guerrilla Adepts to designate one enemy, excluding VEHICLES and MONSTERS. Throughout that phase the designated foe is the shooter’s sole permitted target, subject to normal eligibility. If the shooter lands at least one hit, mark the target Assailed until your next [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) opens. If already Assailed it also becomes Pinned through that checkpoint. Pinned reduces its Move by 2 inches and its Charge rolls by 2. The labels serve this ability and can matter for individual Stratagems or Enhancements.

trigger.after: selected to shoot in your Shooting phase

afterAttacks.expires: start of your next Shooting phase
